title: Constructibility of quotient part
statement: The quotient in the constructible short exact sequence argument is constructible.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Proposition 09BH (proposition-constructible-over-noetherian), part (2): on a Noetherian scheme every sub and quotient sheaf of a constructible abelian sheaf is constructible; with Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), which identifies Stacks' affine-local definition with the global finite partition of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion] on the quasi-compact quasi-separated $C$; $C$ is Noetherian, being of finite type over a field. Cited in the proof of Lemma 0A5C (lemma-ses-statements).

proof.text: Install P.isCurve and apply isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType to P.toSpec; the curve is Noetherian.

Convert the abelian sheaves to modules over ULift Z using the equivalence between abelian groups and integral modules, followed by restriction along ULift.ringEquiv. Postcomposition on sheaves is fully faithful and essentially surjective: compose each module sheaf with the inverse coefficient equivalence and use its counit. The induced equivalence is additive, so ShortExact.map_of_exact preserves the given sequence. Apply isConstructibleSheaf_integral_iff to identify constructibility of the middle module sheaf with hF.
The mapped first arrow is monic by short exactness. Apply constructible_of_mono_noetherian over the Noetherian ring ULift Z to obtain constructibility of its source.

Apply the existing IsConstructibleSheaf.cokernel declaration in KernelCokernel to the mapped first arrow. Its Lean statement permits arbitrary coefficient rings (the finite-ring formulation of thm-constructible-serre is a specialization). Both source and target are constructible. ShortExact.gIsCokernel identifies the third term with this cokernel; transport constructibility across coconePointUniqueUpToIso using IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iso.
Apply isConstructibleSheaf_integral_iff to F₂ with its supplied torsion proof h₂ to return to the unchanged CurveCoefficientPair.IsConstructible conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 09BH (2), implemented through canonical integral coefficients instead of a finite annihilator and cyclic coefficients; subobject then cokernel route unchanged.

split_report.summary: Strict intermediate conclusion split from the parent six-step proof; remaining proof follows the parent node.

lean.statement: theorem constructible_quot_part {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (P : AlgebraicGeometry.CurveCoefficientPair k) (F₁ F₂ : Sheaf P.C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h₁ : P.C.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F₁) (h₂ : P.C.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F₂) (α : F₁ ⟶ P.F) (β : P.F ⟶ F₂) (w : α ≫ β = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk α β w).ShortExact) (hF : P.IsConstructible) : AlgebraicGeometry.CurveCoefficientPair.IsConstructible { P with F := F₂, isTorsion := h₂ }
